name: Hardware Product Template
description: Template for ASIC, SoC, FPGA, or mixed-signal hardware projects

suggestedColors.name: design
suggestedColors.description: RTL modules, schematics, design documents, configuration registers

suggestedColors.name: verification
suggestedColors.description: Testbenches, assertions, coverage groups, test plans

suggestedColors.name: cv
suggestedColors.description: Characterization and validation measurements, lab results

sketchDesignQuestions: What is the top-level product name and its major subsystems?
What specification documents exist and how are they structured?
What is the RTL module hierarchy (top module down to leaf modules)?
Are there configuration registers? What is the register map structure?
What verification environments exist (UVM testbenches, formal, etc.)?
What test plans and coverage models are in place?
Are there characterization/validation (CV) measurements or lab data?
What traceability links exist (requirements to design, design to verification)?
What source systems hold this data (Git repos, document servers, databases)?
Are there any analog/mixed-signal blocks that need special handling?
